reuse.why: Keeps using getDateWithSkippedWeekend and date-fns inside getNextDate, but adds the daily rule as inline special-casing rather than a shared predicate the other weekend-handling paths could use.

duplication.why: No copied logic; the change is a single inline block in getNextDate.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate where weekend handling lives, though inline in that function rather than in a named helper.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: The daily-skip rule exists only in getNextDate, while getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule template still move weekend occurrences via getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly, and the unexplained subDays(start, 1) and nested skip branches make the function harder to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: the change itself goes through getNextDate; the other weekend paths (schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates, budget/schedule-template.ts) are left calling getDateWithSkippedWeekend without the new rule

one_place.where: rule added inline only in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts apply weekend moves without it
